HomePage.title: Find Free Parking
HomePage.searchPlaceholder: Search for an address or place
HomePage.regionNotSupportedDesc: Verified parking rules are not available here. Gray features are unverified map context.
HomePage.metaDescription: Explore parking map context and listed meter payment hours. Free permission requires current authoritative evidence; check posted signs.
HomePage.metaKeywords: free parking, street parking, parking map, parking meters, parking rules, cheap parking
HomePage.mayRequirePayment: May require payment or permit. Check signs.
HomePage.restrictionsApply: Restrictions may apply (e.g. No Parking, Arterial). Check signs.
HomePage.unknownGuidance: Parking permission is unverified. Check posted signs; they take precedence.
HomePage.unverifiedLot: Unverified lot: may be customers only. Check access, hours and payment at the entrance.
HomePage.driverWarning: Driver Warning: {count} report(s) of {status}; latest {date}. Advisory only.
HomePage.cityNoRestrictionFound: This map also shows places where no restriction was found in official data.

noRestrictionFound.noLimit: Not verified: official data shows no payment or restriction here. Posted signs and parking laws (hydrants, driveways, crosswalks) still apply.
noRestrictionFound.limitFits: Not verified: official data shows no payment here. Limit: {limit}. Posted signs and parking laws still apply.
noRestrictionFound.noPaymentSource: Not verified: official data shows no restriction here, and payment is not recorded for this place. Posted signs and parking laws (hydrants, driveways, crosswalks) still apply.
noRestrictionFound.limitNoPaymentSource: Not verified: payment is not recorded for this place. Limit: {limit}. Posted signs and parking laws (hydrants, driveways, crosswalks) still apply.
noRestrictionFound.missingCategories: No official dataset here records the following, so they were not checked: {categories}.
noRestrictionFound.measurement: Checked {sampled} places against {signal}: {misses} had a restriction the other data missed (up to about 1 in {oneIn}).

ReportModal.title: Update Status
ReportModal.submittedDesc: Your report has been submitted for review.

HelpModal.title: How to convert to free parking
HelpModal.desc: Gray means Unknown and stays visible in both views. Red meters list payment hours; they do not establish permission to park.
HelpModal.redLines: Red lines are paid or restricted.
HelpModal.doubleCheckDesc: Read all posted signs and entrance conditions before parking. The map does not observe vacant spaces.
HelpModal.betaDesc: This app is under active development. Please expect occasional issues.
HelpModal.evidenceDesc: Free parking needs current authoritative rules for the location, time and vehicle. Legacy map data does not verify free permission. Driver Warnings are dated observations and never change a rule.
